get_env_class_by_name: get the Habitat RL environment class from the baseline registry by its registered name
create_RearrangeRLEnv_instance: create a RearrangeRLEnv instance with a config and optional dataset for rearrangement RL tasks
create_NavRLEnv_instance: create a NavRLEnv instance with a config and optional dataset for navigation RL tasks
review_RearrangeRLEnv_reward: review the RearrangeRLEnv get_reward method to understand how reward measures and success bonuses are computed
review_NavRLEnv_sparse_reward: review the NavRLEnv get_reward method to understand how sparse reward with slack and success bonuses works
